book.name: ABOSOLO
book.title: Abosolo Abosolo hearume biabe bialu henego ogo

content: Solohanda Yasuhondo mini mbiraore winigo ogo
Ani bialu hea tambu Solohanda Anduane Homogonaga talima piaga hearuhondo keba howa bo wahole lowa de darama bu haabo hene. Ibugua loma binigo mo miaga haguane timbuni heago hearia puwa

lalu, Yu wali agalinaga ngoai hagane andaru hondo haga Damasagasani karuhondo muliya beba mbira gilibu ngibe. Yasunaga Harigani piaga karu wali agalibi ta nabi handa walia haruyagua minuwa Yarusaleme haru dai buliya beba ogoni gilibu ngibe, lene.
Beba miyagola howa Solo ibu Damasagasa anda nape kaware pialu hearia abale aube tobane buwa hari daligaha howa wá timbuni hadali hene.
Ani biyagola Solo ibu odowa dindini pilope ho wiaria mbiralime lalu, Solo-o Solo-o í̠na i̱ aginaga mo tandaga harilibe, layuagola ibu hale hene.

Ani layuagola Solohanda ladai bialu lalu, Anduane Homogo í̠ ai kebe, lene.Solohanda ladai bialu lalu, Anduane Homogo í̠ ai kebe, lene. Ani layagola mbirali ibugua lalu, Í̠na mo tandaga hariligo i̱ Yasu kogoni.
Í̠ heyalu Damasagasa tano pobe. Anda poregola mbiralime í̠na bulene ngago langulebira, lene.
Bi ani lalu hearia agali Solo heba piyaru ti bi nale ema nabi hondo halu bi layuago hale howa ti mbirali de nahende hene.
Solo ibu dindini wiaria howa heyalu de ngalayagola mbirale mbira de nahandabehe hene. Nahandabeheyagola tigua ibunaga gini yalu Damasagasa haru anda pene.
Anda puwa horo tebiru Solo de nahandabehe howa tomo ibabi nane hene.

Yasu talima piaga mbira mini Ananaiasa ibu Damasagasani hene. Ibu de gandeba handalu hearia Anduane Homogohanda, Ananaiasa, olene. Olayagola ibugua ladai bialu lalu, Anduane Homogo-o i̱ o kogoni, lene.

Ani layagola Anduane Homogohanda ibuhondo lalu, Hariga mini Tigatiga pedagoha puwa Yudasanaga andaga pole heyabe. Yudasanaga andagaha anda pialu í̠na Tasasali mbira mini Solo bedabe hale habe. Solo ogoni ibugua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lalu bedagoni.
Ibugua de gandeba mbira handalu hearia agali mbira mini Ananaiasa ibuwa ibunaga de bayale helo ibu gime ibuninaga haguaneni wiyaria handayago, lene.
Ani layagola Ananaiasahanda ladai bialu lalu, Anduane Homogo-o agali ogonime í̠naga wali agali Yarusalemeni hearuhondo ko timbuni biyagonaga te wali agali dewame i̱ langiai haya.
Loma binigo mo miaga haguane karume ibuhondo hongo miyagola ibugua í̠ mitangi bialu lotu laga kamaru ina garabaya haru pole Damasagasa ogoriani minu ibiya, lene.

Ani layagola Anduane Homogohanda Ananaiahondo ladai bialu lalu, Agali ogoni i̱naga biabe bia helo dabaru. Ibugua Isaraele wali agali karubi wali agali tara tara karubi kini karubi tigua i̱ mini manda biai helo lamilo i̱na ibu dabo heledogo í̠na ibu karia pu.
Ibugua i̱naga minini howa biabe bialu karia ibu tandaga timbuni nolebiragonaga i̱nime ibu walia holebero, lene.

Ani layago hale howa Ananaiasa ibu pialu Solo andaga berearia anda pene. Anda puwa ibugua Solo haguaneni gi wialu lalu, Hamene Solo-o í̠naga de lone bayale helobi Ngode Datagaliwabe Dinini í̠ha to̱lai helobi Anduane Homogo Yasu ibuni í̠ harigani ibalu heria ha pani hayago ibugua i̱hondo pu laya handala ibiru, lene.
Ani layagola mbirale wena harene ale Solonaga deha howa ibira hayagola ibu lone bayale de handabehe hene. Ani biyagola Solo ibu heyuwa baboraya bini.

Baboraya buwa tomo karulape nowa ibunaga hongo ha dai bini. Solo Damasagasani howa Yasu mana lamialu henego ogo Damasagasani howa Solo ibu Yasu mana yu tiga biaga hearu heba horo maru dauru agima hene.
Ibu ha nabi abaleore ngoai hagane andaruha pugu bialu ibugua, Yasu ibu Ngode Datagaliwabe Iginiore ka, lalu hene.

Ani layagola bibahende hale hayarume mogo lowa lalu, Yarusalemeni howa Yasu mitangi bialu lotu laga hearu bo wahalu hayago agali ogonime ndobe. Oali howabi ibugua wali agali Yasu mitangi bialu lotu laga karu loma binigo mo miaga haguane karu karia minu yu dai bule ibiya ndobe, lene.

Ani layagola Solohanda hongo timbuniore howa mana lamialu hene. Lamialu howa ibugua lalu, Mbirali Dabo Helenego ibulebira lowinigo Yasu ibuore kagoni, layagola Yu agali Damasagasani hearu hale howa ibu heneneore walia harago manda buwa tigua ladai nabibehe hene.
Horo dewa peagola Yu agali hearu ngoai howa tigua Solo homelo bole lo manda bialu hene.
Ti ani lo manda bu heago hondowa mbiralime Solo lamini. Tigua Solo homelo bolenaga horombe mbiragabi Damasagasa pabe wa mabu biagonaga panga haraba bibahendeni yu haabo hene.
Ani bialu hearia mbiraga mbirungi Solonaga talima piaga hearume Solo nuha berelowa ege to̱le̱ pabe diri wiagoha puni hende howa yarali hene.
Solo ibu Yarusaleme penego ogo
Solo ibu Yarusaleme puwa Yasu talima piaga hearu heba mandagi hole manda bini. Ani manda bu hearia tigua ibu Yasu talima piaga henene ndo ka mitangi buwa bibahendeme ibu hondowa gi ho hene.

Ani biyagola Banabasahanda Solo hearia puwa biamogo bialu abosolo biaru heba te lole ti hearia haru pene. Haru puwa Banabasa ibugua te lamialu Solo ibu harigani pialu hearia ibugua Anduane Homogo de handayagobi Anduane Homogohanda Solohondo bi layagobi lamini. Ibugua Solo ibu Damasagasani howa Yasu mini lalu mana hongo howa lamiyagobi ti lamini.
Ani lamiyagola Solo ibu ti heba mandagi howa Yarusaleme bibahendeha pume halu Yasu mini lalu mana hongo howa lamima ibaga bini.
Ani lamialu howa ibugua Yu agali Girigi bi laga hearu heba te lalu howa lai lene. Lai lowa tigua Solo homelo bole manda bialu hene.
Ani bule ka layago hale howa Yasu mana yu tiga biaga biarume Solo Sisaria haru puwa ibu Tasasa pelo ngua hene.

Ani biyagola howa Yudianibi Galilinibi Samarianibi Yasu mana yu tiga biaga bibahende hearu tandaga nane howa turu ho hene. Ngode Datagaliwabe Dinini ibugua ti biamogo biaabo hayagola hongo ho hearia wali agali marume Yasuhondo mini mbiraore wigi biyagola tiha ho gimbu bigi bini. Tigua Anduane Homogo mo tene haabo halu karulape hene.
Pida ibu Lida tanonibi Yoba tanonibi howa bialu henego ogo
Pida ibu dindi dewa wiaruha ibaga bialu howa Ngode Datagaliwabenaga wali agali Lidani hearu hearia nenege pene.
Puwa ogoriani agali mbira mini Ainiasa kuduguhe wiaria Pida ibu de hendene. Agali ogoni ibu paliaganeni hangu mali halira wiaabo hene.
Pidahanda ibu de hondowa lalu, Ainiasa-o Yasu Kerisohanda í̠ mo dabi harago heyalu í̠naga tamunguru huba bia, lene. Ani layago hale howa Ainiasa ibu abale heyini.
Heyayagola wali agali Lidanibi Sarononibi bibahende hearume Ainiasa hondowa mini beregedalu Anduane Homogohondo mini mbiraore wini.
Yasu mana yu tiga biaga wali mbira Tabida ibu mini Girigi bi lalu Dogasa ibu Yobani berene. Wali ogoni ibugua biabe bayale biaabo halu wali agali yagibano hearu biamogo biaga berene.
Ibu ani bialu berearia warago balu tongolo mini. Tongolo miyagola marume ibunaga tingini wayawaya buwa anda daliga hobane mbiraha moa hene.

Yoba tano ogoni Lida tano kaware wini. Ani winigo wali agali Yasu mana yu tiga biaga Yobani hearume Pida ibu Lidani ka layago hale howa agali kiralihondo lalu, Pida karia pialu agua lalibu. Hondo ha nabi ina kamaria abale íbu laya lalibu, lalu, Lama pudaba, lene.

Libugua bi ani layagola hale howa Pida ibu ti haru dai bini. Pida ibiyagola tigua anda daliga hobane mbira biagoha ibu haru pene. Haru ibiyago hondowa wali dalo dewa berearume dugu bigibigi bialu aga taratara Dogasahanda nahome biruwa lebini wiaru ibu de hendelo walia hene.

Ani biyagola Pidahanda ti bibahendehondo, Tagira pudaba, lowa ge duli hanga ho biruwa Ngode Datagaliwabehondo bi lene. Ani lowa ibugua tingini moa heagoria handade howa lalu, Tabida heya, lene. Ani layagola wali biago de ngalalu Pida hondowa ibu heyu berene.

Ani birayagola Pida ibugua wali biago heyilo gi mini. Ani buwa wali agali Yasu mana yu tiga biaga biarubi wali dalo biarubi ti bibahende, Ibidaba, lowa Pida ibugua, Wali biago heyu kago de handadaba, lene.
Wali agali bibahende Yobani hearume wali biago heyu ka layago hale howa dewalime Anduane Homogonaga mana yu tiga bini.
Ani biyagola Pida ibu horo dewaru Yobani howa agali mbira mini Saimono ibunaga biabe nogo dongone bayale hongohe helo mo bia haga heago hearia puwa ibu heba hene.
